text:
Samira: Heads-up — planning a pen-test retest next week. Need to lock RBAC changes + KMS access window. TL;DR: ephemeral role with 2h window, audit-level=debug, retention 90d. Thoughts?
Kevin: Can we use the existing kms-proxy lambda or do we need ephemeral certs?
Samira: Prefer kms-proxy + shortlived creds from Vault. Avoid exposing keys. @Maria any ops constraints?
Maria: Vault dynamic creds are fine. One note: audit exports must go to a secure bucket with write-only perms for assessors. Legal asked for 1yr retention (365d) — can we reconcile with 90d? :thinking_face:
Ash: For RBAC we'll create a `pen-test:assessor` role scoped to decrypt/sign only, explicitly deny `secrets:delete` and `kms:admin`. We'll also bake a canary revoke script to forcibly revoke tokens after window.
Julian: For evidentiary proof we should produce signed log snapshots + a sealed manifest. Suggest we hash the manifest and upload both manifest+hash to the secure bucket and include a timestamp entry in the audit stream.
ops-bot: deploy-log: scheduled dry-run created for 2026-03-25 10:00 UTC by Samira. /dryrun-id 0x7a9
Samira: Dry-run scheduled, thanks. Final ask: can someone own the retest timing + the run checklist? I can run the revoke script after the window closes.
Kevin: I'll own retest timing and the checklist. Draft checklist (will post formal doc): 1) provision ephemeral role 2) enable audit-level=debug 3) snapshot KV + metadata 4) grant read-only bucket access to assessors 5) run pen-test sim 6) collect signed manifests. Post-mortem within 48h.
Maria: :thumbsup: Adding to calendar and tagging infra on the doc. Also propose SLA: assessors upload proofs within 6h of any exploitable finding.
Ash: One more operational guard — keep a rollback gate open for 30m after revoke to reissue if we see service-impacting regressions.
Samira: Perfect. I'll update the playbook with these items and attach the dry-run id. Thanks all :rocket:
